test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The crowd gave them a ________ of applause.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase** "a round of applause"** is **a common expression used to describe the act of clapping hands in appreciation or approval.**
 
• The other options** ("yell", "load", "laugh")** do not fit **the context of giving applause.**
 
• A **"round" **in this context refers to **a burst or session of applause, making it the most appropriate choice.**

Hence, the correct statement is: ***The crowd gave them a round of applause__***__**.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• In English, certain expressions are fixed and commonly used in specific contexts. "A round of applause" is one such fixed expression.
 
• Understanding common expressions and idioms is crucial for mastering the nuances of the language.
